text: Hiya, sorry if this is a silly question. I've got my nephew Ollie for the night, he's 8. He's full of cold, nose running, sneezing his head off. He's wide awake and chatting to me, watching cartoons, completely with it. I just don't know how much Calpol or ibuprofen I can give him at his age, his mum's away and I don't want to get it wrong. Oh and there's a bruise on his shin but that's from falling off the climbing frame this afternoon, he told me all about it, it's just the one.
